periods.summary: Utakata travels to Osaka with the student council, immediately complains that the crowd and heat make him sick, and wants to reach the hotel. He asks about Toka's whereabouts and later watches the final with the others, reacting to the severe damage Stella causes to the ring and audience area.

key_events.summary: Arrives with the student council and pushes the group to escape the crowd.

periods.summary: Utakata's causality-interference Noble Art makes him invaluable to special conscription even though his direct combat ability is low. He guides student knights to escaped prisoners' hiding places, including the Dragunov arena. Back in Fukuoka he notices the changed neighborhood around Wakaba House, reacts fiercely to the harassment and nearly uses Absolute Uncertainty to identify the garbage vandalism culprit. Harima stops him, and Utakata later admits that he and Toka were immature for leaning too quickly on personal power rather than trusting others' goodness.

key_events.summary: His support locates the underground arena for the raid.
Nearly uses his ability against the harassers but witnesses the children confess and reconcile.

status.current: hospitalized and recovering after using his ability to keep Toka, Moroboshi, and himself alive in the landslide
status.condition: unconscious for much of the volume, later awake enough to affirm his faith in Toka

relationships.toka-todo: Childhood family from Wakaba House; rushes to rescue her and later states she is strongest when fighting for others.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Receives her warning and guides Moroboshi to Toka.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Guides Moroboshi to the graveyard; later Moroboshi credits Misogi's ability for saving them from the landslide.
relationships.nishikata-hisako: Wakaba House family member concerned for his recovery.

periods.summary: Misogi receives Kanata's emergency call when Toka cannot be reached and rushes toward the graveyard. He arrives just as Tendo is about to burn him with Bansho Kaijin, but Moroboshi's Tiger Bite blocks the attack. Misogi then helps evacuate Toka, but Tendo's earthquake-triggered landslide catches the group. Moroboshi later says they survived because Misogi used his result-manipulating ability to protect them, though Misogi falls unconscious and remains hospitalized. Near the end, he wakes and calmly tells Rio that Toka's victory was never in doubt because Toka is strongest when fighting for others.

key_events.summary: Arrives to rescue Toka, is saved from Tendo's fire, then helps carry Toka away.
Is reported unconscious after using his ability during the landslide.
Watches the cleared sky from the hospital and expresses confidence in Toka.
